items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I worked with her too, I worked with her as a silver lead orchestra... we worked together quite a little while.

ctx.x: Well, I could name some woman piano players. Well, name one that might be.
Camilla Todd, Mercedes, Homer Fields? Well, I worked with her too, I worked with her as a silver lead orchestra. Oh.
Mercedes, Homer Fields? No, she wasn't in that band. She wasn't in that band. No, she wasn't in that band.
